summary: Backend + frontend testing for /checkin and /submit features. pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_checkin_submit.py: 30/30 PASS (validation, 404 for NW-0000, idempotent check-in with preserved checked_in_at, no PII leakage, admin attendance count, LLM failure path with monkeypatched score_submission saving submission + feedback_status=unavailable, success shape with mocked model, parse_feedback never invents scores). New live-URL regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_live_checkin_submit.py: 8/8 PASS against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (checkin 422/404, NW-KGGN already_checked_in=true with first_name only + no @ in body + stable checked_in_at, /submit 422 bad title/link, 404 unknown seat with valid body, /api/admin/stats auth-gated and returns attendance keys {checked_in, registered, submissions, feedback_unavailable}). Frontend /checkin, /submit, /admin, /ticket/:code owner view all verified via mobile viewport (390x844): valid NW-KGGN check-in shows 'Already checked in, Ravi' with checked_in_at; /submit form has char counter (105/600), submit button correctly disabled on bad title/link and enabled on valid input; admin dashboard shows attendance card with checked_in=4 submissions=4 (0 without feedback); ticket owner view (with hallticket.my_seat set as JSON string) shows ticket-checkin-link + ticket-submit-link and navigates to /checkin. No real LLM scoring was triggered to avoid quota and the 6/10m-per-IP rate limit (NW-KGGN already submitted once per prompt).
critical_code_review_comments: feedback.py correctly treats any non-conforming LLM output as unavailable and never invents a score (good).

/api/admin/login response uses 'access_token' (JWT) rather than 'token'; prompt text said 'Bearer token from POST /api/admin/login' — behavior is consistent with existing tests but noting the key name for any future client code.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (checkin, submit validation, admin attendance, ticket owner CTAs)

seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing seat NW-KGGN per prompt. pytest fixture registers a throwaway seat via /api/register inside TestClient.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /submit is rate-limited to 6 valid submissions / 10 min / IP, and admin login to 10/10m/IP; register endpoint to 12/10m/IP. Avoid loops that re-login or re-register. NW-KGGN is already checked in and has >=1 submission with feedback. For LLM success-path assertions, monkeypatch server.score_submission inside TestClient instead of hitting the real model. Owner-only ticket CTAs require localStorage key 'hallticket.my_seat' to be JSON-encoded (i.e. value stored as '"NW-KGGN"').
